messages:
support_lead: FYI — receiving a customer escalation: multiple 502/504s hitting hosted inference for tenant `tenant-42` during a burst. Customer reports timeouts when sending 10-20 req/s bursts.
amelia: saw the alerts. Gateway 504s spiked at 08:12 UTC, coincident with a big queue backlog.
raj: any linkage to autoscaler events? HPA/KEDA logs?
support_lead: +1 — initial glance shows KEDA scaledobject cooldowns + a slow model init (coldstart) on nodes. Also billing throttle spike for that tenant around same time.
mike: I pulled KEDA controller logs — saw ScaleUp request at 08:11:54 but readiness probe kept failing for new pods. Readiness failures due to model init timeout.
sara: model-init logs from pod-xyz:
```
[08:11:55] loading weights
[08:12:14] downloading shard 3/6 (slow S3 read)
[08:12:40] model init timed out after 25s
[08:12:41] readiness probe failed: HTTP 500
```
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-112 (linked). Priority P1.
amelia: interesting — S3 read slowdown could be from network egress limits or noisy neighbor. But why did KEDA not add more replicas sooner? ScaledObject cooldown is 60s in tenant-42.
raj: config snippet from scaledobject we have: `cooldownPeriod: 60`, `pollingInterval: 30`, `minReplicaCount: 0`, `maxReplicaCount: 8` — with min=0 we rely on coldstarts.
mike: Also saw KEDA metric backend delay: metrics API returned 429s for short window (billing backend rate limit). KEDA polls missed spikes -> delayed scale decision.
sara: Repro steps I just ran:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"x"}' repeated 20x concurrently
2) within 15s, gateway responded with 504s for requests queued behind coldstart pods
Observed gateway logs: `upstream_read_timeout`, `502 connection reset by peer`

raj: hypothesis: combination of (a) minReplicaCount:0 causing coldstarts, (b) KEDA cooldown + pollingInterval too coarse, (c) metric delays due to billing/throttle -> slow scale up, (d) model init time > readiness probe timeout.
opsbot: @infra_oncall assigned.
infra_oncall: on it. First immediate mitigation: increase minReplicaCount for high-traffic tenants, and bump readiness probe timeout to allow model init.
support_lead: customer asked for repro steps and ETA. Can we suggest short-term config changes they can apply?
amelia: suggest: set minReplicaCount:2 for tenant-42, set cooldownPeriod:20, pollingInterval:5 (if allowed), readinessProbe.timeoutSeconds:60, and increase model-init timeout. Also consider preloading commonly used models into prefix cache to avoid shard fetch.
mike: long-term: move critical model layers to faster storage or warm image with model cached on node (warmboot). Also evaluate KEDA-based scaling to use external metrics that are less impacted by billing throttles.
sara: I pushed a quick patch to readiness timeout on canary for tenant-42 -> deployed at 08:25 UTC. Monitoring.
raj: I'll prepare checklist for runbook: include checks for billing API errors, KEDA metrics 429, S3 latency, and readiness probe failures.
infra_oncall: monitoring shows 504s falling to near zero after readiness timeout increase and minReplica bump. Customer notified.
support_lead: customer replied: "latency greatly improved, but wants a guarantee for burst handling." They asked for recommended defaults.
amelia: recommend org-wide defaults: minReplicaCount=1 for prod tenants, cooldown=20s, pollingInterval=5s, readiness timeout=60s, and a prewarm policy for >100 req/s tenants.
sara: logging snippet from gateway during incident:
```
[08:12:12] req_id=abcd upstream_connect_timeout
[08:12:15] req_id=abce upstream_read_timeout
[08:12:41] req_id=abcf 504 queued-request-timeout
```
opsbot: NOTE: add KB entry: "Autoscale coldstart & readiness probe checklist".
support_lead: assigning action items: @raj write runbook patch, @amalia (sic) adjust defaults PR, @mike evaluate warm image for model, @sara follow up with customer. I'll update INC-2026-112.
raj: starting runbook PR now.
amelia: creating defaults PR — small typo fix: my display name is amelia, not amalia :) :laughing: 
support_lead: thanks everyone. Close on improvements after runbook + defaults merged.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread about autoscale coldstart, KEDA/HPA misconfig and warmup delays causing gateway 5xx/504s.
